title: Experts Exhibit Structured Redundancy: Structure-Preserving Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41236v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse MoE mechanism significantly improves the trade-off between model capacity and inference efficiency. However, practical deployment still requires storing all experts, resulting in substantial memory overhead. We show that expert outputs in MoE layers exhibit structured redundancy. Across different models and task categories, the stable rank and entropy effective rank of expert outputs are consistently far below the nominal number of experts, while expert output distributions also exhibit fewer effective modes. Motivated by these observations, we reformulate expert pruning as a structure-preserving expert subset selection problem and efficiently optimize it via a greedy strategy, rather than only independently scoring and ranking individual experts or exhaustively searching over expert combinations. translated_title: 专家呈现结构化冗余：面向混合专家大语言模型的结构保持专家剪枝
translated_abstract: 稀疏混合专家机制显著改善了模型容量与推理效率之间的权衡。然而，实际部署仍需存储所有专家，从而带来巨大的内存开销。我们证明，MoE层中的专家输出表现出结构化冗余。在不同模型和任务类别中，专家输出的稳定秩和熵有效秩始终远低于专家的名义数量，同时专家输出分布也表现出更少的有效模态。受这些观察启发，我们将专家剪枝重新表述为一个结构保持的专家子集选择问题，并通过贪心策略对其进行高效优化，而不是仅仅独立地对单个专家进行评分和排序，或对专家组合进行穷举搜索。我们在统一的结构保持框架下提出了两种专家剪枝方法：投影能量专家剪枝（PEEP），它……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现MoE层专家输出存在结构化冗余（有效秩远低于专家名义数量），并据此将专家剪枝重构为结构保持的专家子集选择问题，通过贪心策略提出PEEP等剪枝方法，在保持模型结构的同时大幅降低存储开销。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals structured redundancy in MoE expert outputs, with effective ranks far below the nominal number of experts, and reformulates expert pruning as a structure-preserving subset selection problem solved via a greedy strategy, proposing methods such as PEEP to reduce memory overhead while preserving model structure.
